findings.text: The task cites an "S6 clarification accepted 2026-10-24" in ADR 0017, but `docs/adr-0017-user-surface.md` on this base holds only the S7 cost clarification (line 82). It has no S6 text on strong equivalence, branch outcomes or conditional/total success. Fix: cite the owner's acceptance in the status file with its date, or add the S6 clarification to ADR 0017 and link it.

The top says "Implementation has not started", but the progress log (lines 203-216) says the task is assigned and the implementation workspace is set up. Fix: change the top to "Assigned; no production code yet".
